title: Core: AS2 inheritance and super keyword
description: Test compilation of: class Animal { function speak() {} }, class Dog extends Animal { function speak() { super.speak(); } }. Test super() constructor call, super.method() calls, super property access. Verify ActionCallMethod (0x52) with 'speak' string, ActionGetVariable for super. Also test multi-level inheritance (A extends B extends C) compiles without error.
